entries.description: Search and download subtitles from the opensubtitles.com catalog and run AI jobs: transcribe media to subtitles, translate subtitle files, detect languages. REST API with pay-as-you-go credits; subtitle search is free. Published by ai.opensubtitles.com, the AI companion site of opensubtitles.com — separate entities that share the same user base and the same API backend; the OpenAPI document served here describes that shared API.
representativeQueries: find subtitles for a movie or TV show
transcribe this video into an SRT subtitle file
translate an SRT subtitle file into another language
what language is this audio or text in
